subject: Great Pyramid of Giza
title: The 5 Tallest Ancient Wonders, Ranked (Only #1 Still Stands)

scenes.text: Six of the Seven Wonders are gone. The tallest is the only one still standing.
Number five: the Hanging Gardens of Babylon. About seventy-five feet tall, if they ever existed.
scenes.label: Hanging Gardens · 75 ft

scenes.text: Number four: the Colossus of Rhodes, a bronze statue of the sun god, about a hundred and five feet tall.
scenes.label: Colossus of Rhodes · 105 ft

scenes.text: Number three: the Mausoleum at Halicarnassus, a marble tomb about a hundred and thirty-five feet high.
scenes.label: Mausoleum · 135 ft

scenes.text: Number two: the Lighthouse of Alexandria. Probably over three hundred fifty feet, with a fire burning on top.
scenes.label: Lighthouse · 350+ ft

scenes.text: Number one: the Great Pyramid of Giza. Four hundred eighty-one feet, the oldest of them all, and the last one left.
scenes.label: Great Pyramid · 481 ft

description:
The Seven Wonders of the Ancient World by estimated height: the Hanging Gardens of Babylon (about 75 ft / 23 m, if they existed), the Colossus of Rhodes (about 105 ft / 32-33 m), the Mausoleum at Halicarnassus (about 135 ft / 41 m), the Lighthouse of Alexandria (probably 350+ ft / over 100 m) and the Great Pyramid of Giza (about 481 ft / 146 m when built).
The Temple of Artemis (columns about 60 ft) and the Statue of Zeus (about 40 ft) come sixth and seventh. All heights except the pyramid's rest on ancient descriptions.
Which lost wonder would you bring back?
first_comment: The Great Pyramid stood as the tallest human-made structure for thousands of years. Which ancient wonder would you visit if it came back?
